title: 艾希·雪原远望
description: 白发艾希在雪原高台静立，冰弓竖直垂于身侧不搭箭，蓝白保暖衣装与远山形成冷峻层次。

art_direction.medium: angular wax-crayon strokes, directional hatching and dramatic hard-edged light on textured paper
art_direction.identity: Ashe is an adult Freljordian archer with long white hair, clear blue eyes, a blue hooded cloak, and distinctive crystalline ornamentation. Preserve her focused human face and athletic adult proportions in a fully covering warm blue-and-ivory tunic, opaque leggings, gloves, and boots. Her large ice bow is held vertically beside her body with no arrow nocked and no aiming posture.
art_direction.scene: She stands on a broad snowy platform overlooking a wide valley, cloak pulled into a clean diagonal by a mild wind. Both feet remain secure and the lowered bow stays separated from her torso. Use a hard pale sun to illuminate one side of her face and angular wax-crayon snow planes, with distant dark ridges and clear empty sky.
art_direction.palette: frost blue, white hair, steel gray, pale gold light
art_direction.weapon_policy: iconic static prop, no attacks or firing

visual_qa.method: up to ten images on a compressed JPEG contact sheet, max edge 1280
